## Ctx.sessionClear() method

Clears session data for the current user.

**Signature:**

```typescript
sessionClear(): Promise<boolean | null>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean \| null&gt;

True if the session was cleared, or null on error.

## Remarks

Removes the session from external cache and resets the local session property.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  await this.sessionClear()
  await this.reply()
}
```
